chapter.heading: Joshua 12
Kings Defeated by Moses
chapter.v: the Arabah eastward:
river Jabbok, the boundary of the Ammonites, that is, half of Gilead,
the slopes of Pisgah;
who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei
to the boundary of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and over half of Gilead to the boundary of Sihon king of Heshbon.
gave their land for a possession to the Reubenites and the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
according to their allotments,
the Hittites, the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites):
the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
the king of Hebron, one;
the king of Lachish, one;
the king of Gezer, one;
the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
the king of Bethel, one;
the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
the king of Hazor, one;
the king of Achshaph, one;
the king of Megiddo, one;
the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
Naphath-dor, one; the king of Goiim in Galilee, one;
the king of Tirzah, one: in all, thirty-one kings.
